newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Trans-shipment traffic at Colombo port hits record.
newsitem.headline: Trans-shipment traffic at Colombo port hits record.

text.p: Container trans-shipment traffic through Colombo port hit a monthly record of 97,288 containers in August, Shipping Ministry spokesman Daya Wijesekera said on Tuesday.
The figure represented a 48 percent jump from 65,721 containers handled a year earlier and the previous monthly record of 93,269 set in July.
"We handled a total of 128,164 containers this August, the highest ever handled in a month," he said, adding the main reason was the rise in trans-shipment traffic.
In July, the Colombo port handled 127,568 containers, according to ministry figures.
Colombo handled just over a million containers last year, up from 972,642 containers in 1994, although its capacity is 1.6 million containers.

The total tonnage handled by Colombo rose 8.3 percent to 14,795,896 tonnes in 1995 from 13,666,167 tonnes a year earlier while the port's revenue rose 12 per cent to 5.5 billion rupees ($103.8 million) over the same period from 4.9 billion rupees.
